title: Non-Asymptotic Global Convergence of PPO-Clip
abstract: arXiv:2512.16565v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning has gained attention for modern Large Language Model post-training. The actor-only variants of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) are widely applied for their efficiency. These algorithms incorporate a clipping mechanism to improve stability. Besides, a regularization term, such as the reverse KL-divergence or a more general \(f\)-divergence, is introduced to control excessive deviation from a reference policy. Despite their empirical success, a rigorous theoretical understanding of the problem and the algorithm's properties is limited. This paper advances the theoretical foundations of the PPO-Clip algorithm by analyzing a deterministic actor-only PPO algorithm within the general RL setting with \(f\)-divergence regularization under the softmax policy parameterization. tldr: 本文为PPO-Clip算法建立了非渐近全局收敛理论，通过在带f-散度正则化和softmax策略参数化的一般强化学习设置中，推导出非一致Lipschitz光滑性条件与Łojasiewicz不等式等关键性质，填补了该算法在严格理论理解方面的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes non-asymptotic global convergence guarantees for PPO-Clip by deriving a non-uniform Lipschitz smoothness condition and a Łojasiewicz inequality for deterministic actor-only PPO with f-divergence regularization under softmax policy parameterization.
